description: List or search work items (jobs/engagements) in Karbon. Useful filters: "PrimaryStatus eq 'InProgress'", "AssigneeEmailAddress eq 'user@firm.com'", "DueDate lt 2026-08-01". PrimaryStatus values: Planned, ReadyToStart, InProgress, Waiting, Completed.

filter.description: OData $filter expression, e.g. "contains(FullName,'Smith')" or "PrimaryStatus eq 'InProgress'". Operators: eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, and, or, contains().

skip.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination

name: list_work_items
title: List work items
